company.shortDescription: Cenote develops Atlassian Confluence apps for document locking and controlled change management workflows.
company.description: Cenote develops software that extends Atlassian Confluence with document locking and controlled change management capabilities. The company focuses on building native Confluence integrations that manage attachment check-in and check-out workflows to prevent overlapping edits. Its primary product, Cenote Lockpoint, enables exclusive document access, attachment locking, and automated unlock behaviors across Confluence Cloud and Data Center environments. Lockpoint integrates with core Confluence features such as the Attachments macro and Edit in App, and supports collaboration with tools like Microsoft Office, Gliffy, and other compatible apps. The software provides configurable notifications, automatic unlock timeouts, and localized interfaces to support distributed teams. Cenote serves enterprises that rely on Confluence to maintain content integrity and protect mission-critical knowledge bases.
